name: my-english-course
description: Desktop wrapper for 我的英语课 (My English Course). Runs the same site, but makes AI chat API calls from Electron's main process instead of the browser page — since that isn't a browser context, it isn't subject to CORS at all, which lets providers that block direct browser requests (e.g. some Kimi endpoints) work here even when they can't from the website.

scripts.prepare-site: rm -rf site && mkdir -p site && cp ../index.html site/ && cp -r ../css ../js ../data ../audio site/
